author: Tavmania
body:
I'll drop a few gear suggestions without offering explanations for each item. Just reply if you want a clarification on why an item is potentially attractive.  

* Dragon's Scroll  
* Heimdall's Shield  
* King's Hood/Robe/Boots, Rhongomiant    
* Cockatrice Mail  
* Horror  
* Grioarvolr (Arena, hard to chase)  
* T9 God staves (Ithra's, Demeter's, Vulcan's)  

Additions from commenters (/u/icemeetsfire22):  

* Yeti Overcoat (snowy weather)  
* Kaladanda, Fallen Shield

author: Maudeth
body: Then hit up the raids and arena. Good gears to be had.

author: Gringus_Khan
body: One thing that I found helped was wielding a legendary horror which causes enemies to drop more items as well as using accessories like bag of treats or presents. At times arena can give you great weapons, for example when I was t8 I got an ornate was... it “was” badass for awhile. Just keep grinding and use the orna guide to asses your items and find the best stuff. A lot of stuff I wind up using is not the items I most coveted, but just the oranges(edit: haha ornate, not oranges) I wound up being lucky enough to get. Best of luck

author: Warfust
body: Look for the fallen gods out in the world, best weapon boost you can get in T8 (are T9 items).

author: BellaRik2
body:
Any legendary t8 shield could give a better ward than that common one... Unless you need dragon protection (for exemple against Sister Macha) you should change it.
Also keep in mind that bosses drops get much more powerful than normal ones even if their stats were slightly worse at level 1.
Nice staff name btw :D

author: Rymachelin
body:
i'd swap the armor for a Cockatrice mail (eventually you'll find one in dungeons/great cockatrice), and i'd go for a dokkalfar boot which seems to be what you are lacking the most. then fallen shoes from mammon.

weapon wise i'd say ithra or demeter is your best opcion, Vulcan also decent! all 3 drop a mage weapon. Stick with horror if you got one.

Heimdall shield is a bless and not very hard to find i guess
